findings.current: “I asked you a question. Why aren’t you answering?”
findings.defect: The prince has given Baek Yeon an order, not asked him a question.
findings.rationale: This preserves the prince’s demand for a response without contradicting his preceding line.
findings.replacement: “I gave you an order. Why haven’t you acknowledged it?”
findings.source: Chapter 863, Prince Shangshan’s exchange with Baek Yeon

findings.current: “His Highness Prince Shangshan, the younger brother of His Majesty the Emperor, is asking you a question! If you don’t answer, that’s an insult to the imperial family! You’re a traitor!”
findings.defect: Taekyung repeats the mistaken description of the prince’s order as a question.
findings.rationale: The accusation then follows from Baek Yeon’s failure to acknowledge an order.
findings.replacement: “His Highness Prince Shangshan, the younger brother of His Majesty the Emperor, has given you an order! If you don’t acknowledge it, that’s an insult to the imperial family! You’re a traitor!”
findings.source: Chapter 863, Jin Taekyung backing Prince Shangshan
